verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, and headless or CI execution is a fair question for a Git tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no CLI, no headless mode and no CI runner integration. The documented automation (Shortcuts actions, x-callback-url, Auto-Sync and Background Sync) runs on-device inside the app. That is an adjacent capability, not running the product headlessly or in CI.
